assets.caption: The scene is a panoramic, futuristic cityscape captured in a vibrant painting style, evoking a sense of wonder and advanced civilization under a celestial sky. The overall tone is magical and serene, as if glimpsing a distant, utopian future. Pathways made of dark cobblestones, subtly illuminated by glowing lines, extend throughout the area, leading to various points in the park. On the left side of the scene, a massive tree with golden-orange foliage stands majestically, its branches adorned with hanging lanterns that cast a warm glow. Beyond this tree, the cityscape unfolds with towering, illuminated structures reaching into the dark, starry sky, hinting at advanced architecture and engineering. To the right, another similar tree, though smaller, contributes to the park's natural beauty, with more lanterns hanging from its branches. Further into the scene, amidst lush flowerbeds filled with white and yellow blossoms, a solitary figure sits on a wooden bench, observing the sprawling metropolis. In the distance, intricate, multi-tiered structures with glass domes are visible, with sleek, winged vehicles soaring through the sky above them. The park is meticulously landscaped with dense clusters of flowering plants and neatly arranged steps leading to elevated sections, all bathed in the soft, ambient light of the city and stars. The scene continues to wrap around, revealing more sections of the meticulously manicured parkland, with additional pathways diverging into the distance, each lined with subtle, glowing markers. The futuristic buildings extend further on all sides, forming a continuous, glowing skyline against the deep blue, star-filled expanse, which includes a prominent, swirling galaxy. The 360 scene is faultless.
